Ivins, UT · Road · Gravel

About the IBB Friday Social Road/Gravel Ride group ride

A social Friday morning ride from IBB Cyclery near St. George. The route runs through Ivins, Santa Clara and Snow Canyon. E-bikes are welcome. RSVP on the shop's Strava club. The shop also runs a fast Monday 6 am mountain bike ride.
